title: Filipino-American History Month.
bodyText: The month of October shall be known and designated as "Filipino-American History Month". The month of October shall commemorate the contributions of Filipino-Americans to the history and heritage of Hawaii and the United States. This month is not and shall not be construed as a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-18]  Filipino-American History Month.  The month of October shall be known and designated as "Filipino-American History Month".  The month of October shall commemorate the contributions of Filipino-Americans to the history and heritage of Hawaii and the United States.  This month is not and shall not be construed as a state holiday. [L 2008, c 15, §2]
